news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.96 loss per share (vs ₹0.89 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.96 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.89 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹59.0m (up 74% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹9.58m (loss widened 8.1% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 39% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 57% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.5% average weekly change). news.title: New minor risk - Financial position
news.body: The company has less than a year of cash runway based on its current free cash flow. Free cash flow: -₹8.8m This is considered a minor risk. With less than a year's worth of cash, the company will need to raise capital or take on debt unless its cash flows improve. This would dilute existing shareholders or increase balance sheet risk. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹210.1m market cap, or US$2.35m). Minor Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on current free cash flow (-₹8.8m). Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.3% average weekly change). Shareholders have been diluted in the past year (30% increase in shares outstanding). Revenue is less than US$5m (₹224m revenue, or US$2.5m).
